name: StoneX: Daily Coffee Report (free insights)
access: browser; pages are named daily-coffee-report-M-D-YY; the site rate-limits (Cloudflare) fast reads
note: Their daily carries charts of arabica/robusta/B3 settlements, arabica switches, robusta switches, the arabica–robusta arb and the arabica–Brazil arb; the desk rebuilds that layout from its own settlements in the Spreads & arbs table.
sugar_line: No free StoneX sugar daily found after August 2026: older sugar & ethanol daily pages now return not-found and the sugar reports page offers a subscription trial.

entries.title: Daily Coffee Report 11/16/26
key_points: Arabica capped below 277 (Mar) as the real weakened (USD/BRL up to about 5.79).
Falling certified stocks (about 186k bags) and Dec open interest of ~12k lots two sessions before first notice supported Dec/Mar, which made new highs (settled near 6¢).
Robusta Jan slid toward the 3,000 support while the Mar/Mar arb widened to new highs.

entries.title: Daily Coffee Report 10/27/26
key_points: Sellers led arabica despite a firmer real; Z/H was offered down from the mid-13s with some short covering lower.
Robusta F/H traded mostly at one level, sellers in control below it.
